title: Ada and the Letter
author: Noor Amberdale
blurb: Coral Nystrom, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
